review_notes: The same three children retain consistent faces, hair, skin tones, clothing, proportions, and premium 3D-style rendering across all six scenes.
The decorated kraft-cardboard construction remains recognizable across opening, bus, cave, theatre, reading-nook, and finale transformations.

No generated title text, logos, watermarks, copied franchise characters, sharp tools, real flames, or unsafe activity were observed.
